results.name: Fpv Racing Drone Quadcopter
results.description:
[**What is FPV?**](https://eagleanurag.blogspot.com/)

FPV stands for [First Person View](https://eagleanurag.blogspot.com/). Basically it means putting a camera on the drone, so you can see what the drone sees while controlling it. It’s like you are sitting in the cockpit and flying like a real pilot, but your feet are actually firmly on the ground.

[Flying](https://eagleanurag.blogspot.com/) a drone in FPV is the most surreal experience I personally have ever had. You can go anywhere in 3D space, what you can do is totally up to your imagination.

[**Flying Mini Quad as Hobby**](https://eagleanurag.blogspot.com/)

More and more pilots are now racing drones on a professional level, but the majority of us just fly them on our days off as a hobby.
![](https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-qXDWrolbqQM/Xw6Zmd_z1bI/AAAAAAAABb0/DpyWCASA3KMRfDySxZH709DjZRJuIDqlQCLcBGAsYHQ/s1600/eagleanurag.jpg)

results.name: Vintage ABBA 8-Track Tape (low-poly)
results.description:
Ok… I’ve never actually seen an 8-track tape in person, so I modeled this from a picture I found online. I don’t even think I know a single ABBA song, but I was watching one of my favorite movies The Martian with Matt Damon and that inspired me to model this since he is stuck on Mars with only Disco music to listen to. I’m not even really sure if ABBA is considered Disco music, but i figured everything during the 1970s was Disco. Anyway, I wanted to model something unique that’s not on Sketchfab and I can proudly say that I currently have the one and only ABBA 8-track tape on Sketchfab. Not sure anyone will ever want this model, but it’s here for free to download it you do.

What horror scene project would be complete without a vintage ABBA 8-track tape sitting on a table or dresser of a spooky house :)

It’s relitively low-poly with only 1742 triangles and PBR textures.

Feel free to use for any project. Any feedback is welcome and appreciated. Thanks for checking out my models and the likes.
